name: Lifeguard training and city pool jobs
org: City of Great Falls Park and Recreation
what_you_do: Get your American Red Cross lifeguard card. Then watch swimmers and handle emergencies at city pools. The city says lifeguards also learn CPR, AED and first aid.
who_can_apply: You must be 15 by the last day of the lifeguard course. You must pass a swim test: 300 yards, 2 minutes treading water, and a timed rescue.
pay_detail: The city page says competitive wages and paid lifeguard certification. Hourly pay is not stated.
deadline_text: Lifeguard openings are posted online when they are available. No dates are posted.
how_to_apply: Look for openings and apply online at the City of Great Falls job site (governmentjobs.com/careers/greatfallsmt). The city phone number on its employment page is 406-771-1180. A Park and Recreation phone number is not stated.
notes: Classes need at least 5 people to run. The city offers certification classes through the year.
